$comment: Generated by `node tools/render-error-catalogue.mjs` from the code constants and tools/error-catalogue-entries.json. Never edit by hand.

body.read: Branch on error.errorCode, never on message text. On a 422, error.details.findings[] carries one {severity, fieldPath, message, code?, guidance?} per problem: fix every ERROR finding, using its code below and its own guidance.

finding.title: Config finding codes
finding.where: findings[].code — on a refused save error.details.findings[].code

graph.title: Pipeline graph codes
graph.where: findings[].code of a Pipeline graph validate or save

lowering.title: Pipeline save refusals
lowering.where: error.details.refusals[].code of a refused PUT /pipelines/{id}/graph (refusals[].code of its validate)

codes.cause: The request could not be read: the body is not a JSON object, a required field or query parameter is missing, or a value has the wrong type or format.
codes.fix: Read the message — it names the field and the shape it wants. Send a JSON object body with every required field, then retry.

codes.cause: The request carries no credentials, or they are invalid or expired.
codes.fix: Sign in again, or refresh the token or API key the request carries.

codes.cause: A path in the request leaves the folder it must stay in (the config root, the data root or a Space's allowed folders), or a draft names a config file a caller may not reach.
codes.fix: Use a path relative to the Space's own folders, with no '..' and no absolute path outside the allowed roots; for a config reference, name the component (kind/name), not a file.

codes.cause: You are signed in, but your role lacks the Capability this route requires, or the object belongs to a Space or share you cannot reach. An agent is also refused routes outside its allowed set.
codes.fix: The message names the Capability. Ask an administrator for a role that holds it, or, for an agent, propose the change for a person to approve instead of calling the route.

codes.cause: The route belongs to a module that is installed but switched off in this Space.
codes.fix: An administrator switches the module on for the Space (PUT /settings/modules), or use a Space where it is on.

codes.cause: Nothing exists at this path or id: a misspelled route, an id that was never created or was deleted, or a name in another Space.
codes.fix: List the collection first (the matching GET) and use an id from it; check the Space in the path. A route of a switched-off module answers MODULE_DISABLED, not this.

codes.cause: The path exists but does not take this HTTP method.
codes.fix: Use the method the API contract (docs/api/openapi-v1.json) lists for this path.

codes.cause: The request clashes with what exists: the name is already taken, the target is used by other configs, or the object is in a state that refuses this action.
codes.fix: Read the message and details: pick another name, or repoint or remove the dependents it lists. Some deletes accept ?force=true when the message says so.

codes.cause: The object changed after you read it: the If-Match version you sent is no longer current, or a concurrent writer kept winning.
codes.fix: GET the object again, re-apply your change to the fresh copy, and resend with its new version or ETag in If-Match.

codes.cause: One demo user is defined differently in two Spaces attached to the same demo server. Demo builds only.
codes.fix: Make that user's row in config/demo-users.toon identical in both Spaces, or attach only one of them, then restart the demo server.

codes.cause: The Space already holds data, so its data folder cannot be changed here.
codes.fix: Move the data folder by hand with the server stopped (see the Space anatomy guide, Config tree vs data root), then set data_root in the Space's space.toon.

codes.cause: No folders are allowed for Spaces on this server (spaces.allowed.roots unset), so every route that takes a Space folder is off.
codes.fix: An operator sets -Dspaces.allowed.roots (or the SPACES_ALLOWED_ROOTS environment variable) to the folders Spaces may use and restarts the server.

codes.cause: The request is over one of the route's caps: the body size (an agent's preview, simulator and MCP bodies are capped at 256 KiB) or a count or quota the message names.
codes.fix: Send less: split the change, page an upload, or reference the data by name instead of inlining it; stay under the limit the message names.

codes.cause: The request parsed but its content is refused: a config that would not load or run, a value out of range, an unknown key, or a reference to something that does not exist. The default code of every 422.
codes.fix: Read error.message and every ERROR in error.details.findings[]: each names its fieldPath, often a code (listed under Config finding codes) and guidance. Fix them all, then resubmit; preview or validate routes check a draft without saving it.

codes.cause: A Safety Policy file in scope exists but cannot be read as a valid policy, so every gate and run in its scope fails closed.
codes.fix: An operator fixes or removes the Space's config/safety-policy.toon (GET /health names the unreadable file), then retries.

codes.cause: The install is read-only: its entitlement expired and the grace period ended, or a trial build has no entitlement. Reads continue.
codes.fix: An administrator installs a renewed entitlement; writes resume without a restart.

codes.cause: Too many expensive requests from you in a short time: your request budget for this route is spent, or one call alone costs more than the whole budget.
codes.fix: When a Retry-After header is present, wait that many seconds and retry. When it is absent, or the message says the call is over the budget, retrying will not help: make the call cheaper (fewer rows, a smaller range) or batch and cache reads.

codes.cause: Stored evidence disagrees with its own recorded hashes, so the store is refused rather than read.
codes.fix: Not fixable from the request. Report it with the correlationId; an operator restores the store from backup or investigates the tampering.

codes.cause: The server failed while answering — a defect or an outage, not a problem with the request.
codes.fix: Retry once. If it repeats, report it with the correlationId from the body; the server log carries the cause under that id.

codes.cause: The route exists but cannot do this for this target on this host — for example run-to-here on a Collector that does not read files.
codes.fix: Use the alternative the message names, or a different target.

codes.cause: The route needs a module or a service this install does not have — not installed in this edition, or a dependency (such as the run lease database) is down.
codes.fix: Check GET /health/details and the edition. Install or enable the module, or wait for the dependency; this is not fixed by changing the request.

codes.cause: Config writes are switched off on this server: it was started without a config write root.
codes.fix: An operator restarts the server with -Dassist.write.root=<config folder>. Reads keep working meanwhile.

codes.cause: A shared store is locked by another request or server and did not free within the bounded wait.
codes.fix: Retry after a short wait. Nothing in the request needs to change.

codes.cause: POST /validate: the component draft is refused as a whole — the message is the refusal the save would give.
codes.fix: Fix what the message names (a missing required key, a bad value, a reference to nothing), then validate again before saving.

codes.cause: A Measure Alert Rule's row filter (when) cannot be applied: it is not a complete condition group (a condition with no field, operator or value, an unknown operator, an empty group), it names a column the Dataset does not have, or it filters on a column the Space masks — an alert never reveals, so it may not count rows by a masked value.
codes.fix: Read the message — it names the condition or column. Complete the condition, use a column from the Dataset's Schema (GET /datasets/{id}/rows lists them), or filter on an unmasked column; a filter on another Dataset needs a derived Dataset first.

codes.cause: The Pipeline is active but has no schema at all, so it would register and then be skipped every cycle.
codes.fix: Give it a schema (processing.schema_file or processing.schemas), or save it with active: false until it has one.

codes.cause: A BI query filter names an operator the compiler does not know.
codes.fix: Use one of: = (eq), != (ne, <>), >, >=, <, <=, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in (with a non-empty value list), isNull, notNull.

codes.cause: A Dataset's calculated[] entry is refused: it is not an object, its name is not a plain identifier, or it has no expr.
codes.fix: Write each entry as {name: <plain identifier>, expr: <SQL expression over the row>}; fieldPath names the entry and the key.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline has chain Steps (steps:, or processing.dedup / summarize / profile / join) but no top-level output_store:, so the chain never runs.
codes.fix: Add output_store: naming the Dataset the chain writes, and a pipeline Job that runs it.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline's Collector cannot be honoured — for example post_action on_success: MOVE with no archive_path.
codes.fix: Set collector.post_action.archive_path (for example archive/yyyy/MM/dd), or choose RETAIN, DELETE or RENAME.

codes.cause: The Schema save removes, renames or narrows a column another config uses, and the Space's Safety Policy sets columns: refuse-breaking.
codes.fix: Repoint the consumers the body lists first, keep the column, or re-send with ?force=true to save anyway.

codes.cause: The request names a column the Dataset does not have: a BI query's orderBy, a Link Analysis query's column or filter field, an Entity Identity or index column.
codes.fix: Read the Dataset's columns (its schema in GET /catalog) and use one of those names; to order a BI query by a measure, use the generated result column <agg>_<FIELD>.

codes.cause: Reading the Dataset's rows failed in the database: its relation names a table or column that does not exist, or a value fails a cast. The message carries the database's text, withheld while masking is in force.
codes.fix: Fix the Dataset's sql, sourceName or calculated columns so the relation reads only its own store's columns, then read again. A Dataset with no files yet answers 409 CONFLICT, not this.

codes.cause: A virtual Dataset carries sql but no sourceName, so nothing names the store its FROM reads. A virtual Dataset reads exactly one store.
codes.fix: Set sourceName to the store the sql reads FROM. To combine two Datasets, derive one with a Pipeline join or an enrichment, not a virtual Dataset.

codes.cause: The Decision Rule has no consequences, or an empty list, so it would do nothing when it matches.
codes.fix: Add at least one consequence {action, params}; the Decision Rule shape (inspecto://shapes/decision-rule) lists the actions.

codes.cause: The Decision Rule has no name.
codes.fix: Add a non-blank name.

codes.cause: The Decision Rule's when is not a condition group, so it would match every row or none.
codes.fix: Write when as {kind: group, op: AND|OR, items: [...]}, each item a condition or another group; leave it out to start from an empty AND group.

codes.cause: An active windowed dedup (scope: window(...)) has no order_by tie-break, or its scope: value is malformed — a durable ledger must never record a random winner.
codes.fix: Add an order_by that picks one winner per key, and write scope as window(<duration>).

codes.cause: The config uses a feature this edition does not include — Alert Rules, the post_action MOVE archive, or DuckLake registration (Standard and Advanced only).
codes.fix: Remove the feature from the config, or run the Standard or Advanced edition.

codes.cause: The excel: block is refused — no path, a path leaving the data root, a bad or duplicate sheet name, max_rows out of bounds, an unknown key, or a sheet sql the SQL guard refuses.
codes.fix: Correct the item the message names: a relative path under the data root, unique sheet names, max_rows within bounds, a plain SELECT for sheet sql.

codes.cause: The saved config adds a link to a Pipeline, Connection or other config that does not exist, and the server refuses dangling links.
codes.fix: Create the target first, or correct the name at the finding's fieldPath.

codes.cause: A processing.map.fields[] row calls lookup.reference; the ingest lane cannot resolve a Reference, so every batch would fail.
codes.fix: Move the lookup into a Pipeline transform.sql Step or a transform.join; keep the mapping row to plain expressions.

codes.cause: A Reconciliation's cardinality is not one of the four words.
codes.fix: Set cardinality to one_to_one, one_to_many, many_to_one or many_to_many, or leave it out (many_to_many asserts nothing).

codes.cause: A Reconciliation's compareColumns[] entry is refused: the column is also a key column or the reserved record count, agg is not sum or count, toleranceType is not exact, absolute or percent, or tolerance is negative.
codes.fix: Write each entry as {column, agg: sum|count, toleranceType: exact|absolute|percent, tolerance: >= 0}, and compare only columns that are not keys.

codes.cause: The request body lacks a field this route requires; the finding's fieldPath names it (for example dataset, startNode, value, ids, or a column key such as sourceCol).
codes.fix: Add the field at fieldPath and resend. The route's request shape is in docs/api/openapi-v1.json.

codes.cause: A request field holds a value outside its fixed set; the message lists the allowed values (a Link Analysis query's direction).
codes.fix: Send one of the values the message lists, spelled as listed.

codes.cause: An active route: branch's where: reads a column the declared schema does not carry, so the branch would fail on the first row.
codes.fix: Use a column the schema declares in the where: predicate (check spelling and case), or add the column to the schema.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline's route: block would refuse to arm; the finding's message names each reason.
codes.fix: Correct the branch at the finding's fieldPath as its message and guidance say, or save with active: false and fix it before activating.

codes.cause: The config would advance progress state (a remote, database-export or Kafka Collector, content dedup, markers with duplicate_check, windowed dedup, a Job's incremental_column) in a Space whose Safety Policy sets permit.advance_state: false.
codes.fix: Remove the state-advancing setting, or have an administrator allow it in the Space's Safety Policy.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline's schema_file resolves to no file beside its config, so it would register and never load.
codes.fix: Name the schema file as it is saved (usually <name>.toon in the same folder), or save the Schema first.

codes.cause: A delimited or fixed-width Pipeline's schema selects a column by name where the load needs its zero-based index in raw.fields[].selector.
codes.fix: Set each raw.fields[].selector to the column's zero-based position (0, 1, 2, …).

codes.cause: Two sinks[] destinations register into the same DuckLake catalog and table, so every batch would insert both destinations' files into it.
codes.fix: Give each destination its own DuckLake table, or merge them into one destination.

codes.cause: A sql Step's fields[] row carries column metadata (description, unit, classification, synonym) that is not a plain string, or names no distinct output column (blank or duplicate name).
codes.fix: Give each fields[] row a unique name matching an output column, and plain string metadata values.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline's lookup, profile, dedup or filter Step would be refused at run time: a required key is missing or malformed, or it names a column the declared schema does not carry.
codes.fix: Fix the Step at the finding's fieldPath: add the missing key, or use a column the schema declares (check spelling and case).

codes.cause: An active Pipeline lists processing.disabled_steps that cannot be parked. Only the sinks of route: branches can be disabled; an unknown or upstream step, the route node itself, every branch at once, or a Pipeline with no dirs.backup is refused.
codes.fix: Disable only route-branch sinks, keep at least one branch live, and set dirs.backup; to stop everything, save active: false instead.

codes.cause: An active summarize Step applies sum or avg to a field the schema declares as non-numeric; the database refuses it at run time.
codes.fix: Aggregate a numeric field, use count / min / max, or declare the field with a numeric type in the schema.

codes.cause: A column carries a classification this Space does not know, so it would mask nothing.
codes.fix: Use a classification the Space defines (its Entity Types and masking classes), or define the new class first.

codes.cause: The config carries a block or key no component reads; the engine would ignore it and what it configures would be lost.
codes.fix: Remove the key, or move it to where the component reads it (check spelling and nesting against the kind's shape).

codes.cause: A webhook: block names a Connection that is not an https one; the webhook sink accepts only https.
codes.fix: Name an https Connection.

codes.cause: A webhook: block names a Connection this Space does not hold, so every run would refuse before sending.
codes.fix: Create the Connection first, or name an existing https Connection.

codes.cause: The webhook: block itself is refused — an inline url: or token:, an unknown key, no connection, or a batch_size out of bounds. The message is the parser's own.
codes.fix: Put the URL and secret in an https Connection and name it in connection:; remove unknown keys; keep batch_size within the bounds the message gives.

codes.cause: The component carries a key nothing reads. A person's save keeps it with no effect (a WARNING, warnings[].code); for an agent the same finding is an ERROR and its save is refused.
codes.fix: Remove the key or correct its spelling against the kind's shape; prefix it with x- to mark it as deliberately extra.

codes.cause: The same missing output_store: on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Add output_store: before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The Pipeline has a chain and an output_store:, but no enabled Job of type: pipeline names its file, so the chain never runs.
codes.fix: Create or enable a Job with type: pipeline and pipeline_config: naming this Pipeline's file.

codes.cause: The same Collector problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Fix the Collector before you set active: true.

codes.cause: Remote-only Collector keys (fetch, retry, circuit_breaker, a non-RETAIN post_action) on a Collector that reads a local inbox — they are accepted but never act.
codes.fix: Bind a remote Connection, or remove the keys; a local inbox's throttle is processing.intake.

codes.cause: The Schema save removes, renames or narrows a column another config uses; the save went ahead.
codes.fix: Update the consumers the finding lists, or they fail at their next run.

codes.cause: The same windowed-dedup problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Add order_by and a valid scope before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The saved config links to something that does not exist; the save went ahead.
codes.fix: Create the target or correct the name, or the config fails when it runs.

codes.cause: The same unknown-column predicate on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Fix the where: predicate before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same route: problem as ERR_ROUTE_UNARMABLE on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Correct the branch before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same unresolved schema_file on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Fix schema_file before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same Step problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Fix the Step before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same disabled_steps problem on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Correct disabled_steps before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same non-numeric measure on an inactive draft; it will refuse at activation.
codes.fix: Fix the measure before you set active: true.

codes.cause: The same unread key in a config already on disk, reported while reading rather than saving.
codes.fix: Remove or move the key at the next edit.

codes.cause: An imported Pipeline binds a Connection this Space does not hold. Bundles never carry Connections (secrets never travel), so the import lands inactive.
codes.fix: Create the named Connection in this Space, then activate the Pipeline.

codes.cause: Data edges form a loop; a Pipeline must be a directed graph without cycles.
codes.fix: Remove one edge of the loop the message lists.

codes.cause: An edge starts at a node id the graph does not have.
codes.fix: Correct the edge's from: to an existing node id, or add the node.

codes.cause: An edge points at a node id the graph does not have.
codes.fix: Correct the edge's to: to an existing node id, or add the node.

codes.cause: Two nodes in the graph share one id.
codes.fix: Give every node a unique id, and update the edges that point at the renamed one.

codes.cause: The Pipeline graph has no nodes.
codes.fix: Add at least an entry node and the Steps it feeds.

codes.cause: An edge carries data into a node type that does not accept data.
codes.fix: Point the edge at a node that accepts it, or use a relationship the target accepts (the message lists them).

codes.cause: An edge uses a relationship its source node type does not emit.
codes.fix: Use one of the relationships the message lists for that node type.

codes.cause: An outcome or route edge targets a node that can neither accept that relationship nor read it as rows — an entry node, or a specialised consumer fed the wrong stream.
codes.fix: Point the edge at a Step or sink that takes rows, or at a consumer of that relationship.

codes.cause: A keyed transform.join's settings cannot run, judged from the config alone.
codes.fix: Correct the key settings the message names.

codes.cause: A transform.join node's match: is not a mode the join runs.
codes.fix: Use one of the match modes the message lists.

codes.cause: A transform.join node names no on: key column(s).
codes.fix: Set on: to the key column, or a list of them, present on both sides.

codes.cause: A transform.join node names no reference. Also the error.errorCode of a 422 from a dry-run when the reference resolves but its file cannot be read; the message names the resolved target.
codes.fix: Set reference: to reference/<pipeline> or a data-file path; when a dry-run cannot read it, seed the reference file or point the node at one that exists.

codes.cause: Every node has an inbound edge, so nothing starts the Pipeline.
codes.fix: Make one node an entry (no inbound edge) — usually the Collector or input node.

codes.cause: A contributed node type declares no mode, so the graph is refused at arming.
codes.fix: The module providing the node type must declare its mode; use a built-in type until it does.

codes.cause: An edge named a relation retired in 4.0.0 (success, failure, on_commit); it was dropped when the graph was read (warning, the run is unchanged).
codes.fix: Remove the edge, or rewire it with a current relationship.

codes.cause: A transform.sql node runs hand-written SQL, which the batch's cast-failure audit does not cover (warning; never blocks a save).
codes.fix: Nothing required. Prefer select / derive Steps when you want cast failures audited.

codes.cause: A transform.join's reference: names a Pipeline or file that does not exist.
codes.fix: Name an existing Reference Pipeline or data file, or create it first.

codes.cause: A node's type is not registered in this build, so its wiring cannot be checked (warning).
codes.fix: Check the type's spelling against the node types this edition lists; install the module that contributes it.

codes.cause: A node's use: names a component kind that does not exist.
codes.fix: Write use: as <kind>/<name> with a component kind this Space has (for example grammar/<name>).

codes.cause: A node's use: names a component of a known kind that does not exist — often a typo.
codes.fix: Name an existing component (list that kind first), or create it.

codes.cause: An enrichment node has a node after it; an enrichment runs after the batch commits, not inside the walk.
codes.fix: Make the enrichment the last node of its chain; put row logic before it in a transform.sql step.

codes.cause: A sink.excel node's config is refused: no path, a bad sheet name, a path leaving the data root, or a sheet sql that is not a plain SELECT.
codes.fix: Correct what the message names: a relative path under the data root, unique sheet names, a plain SELECT per sheet.

codes.cause: A map node authors a columns list while the Pipeline also declares processing.mapping_file.
codes.fix: Keep one: drop the columns list, or drop mapping_file.

codes.cause: The graph has two acquisition nodes; the saved file has one Collector block.
codes.fix: Keep one acquisition node; use a second Pipeline for a second Collector.

codes.cause: The graph has two sink.excel nodes; the saved file has one excel block.
codes.fix: Keep one Excel sink; put more sheets in it.

codes.cause: The graph has two gap-detection nodes; the saved file has one gap_detection block.
codes.fix: Keep one gap node.

codes.cause: Two map nodes carry different config, and the saved file holds one processing.map.
codes.fix: Merge them into one map node, or give both the same config.

codes.cause: The graph has two marker-dedup nodes; the saved file has one set of marker keys.
codes.fix: Keep one transform.dedup.marker node.

codes.cause: The graph has two parser nodes; the saved file has one parse slot.
codes.fix: Keep one parser node.

codes.cause: The graph has two sink.webhook nodes; the saved file has one webhook block.
codes.fix: Keep one webhook sink.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline graph has no acquisition (Collector) node, so it would never read a file.
codes.fix: Add an acquisition node, or save with active: false while it is a draft.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline graph has no parser node.
codes.fix: Add a parser node (for example parser.delimited), or save with active: false while it is a draft.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline graph has no sink that keeps rows, so every batch would be dropped.
codes.fix: Add a persistent sink (a Dataset or file sink), or save with active: false while it is a draft.

codes.cause: A parser.delimited node's parsing.frontend names a different frontend.
codes.fix: Remove parsing.frontend from the node, or use the parser node that matches it.

codes.cause: An active Pipeline graph's parser has no schema.
codes.fix: Give the parser node a schema, or save with active: false while it is a draft.

codes.cause: A transform.sql node has no sql.
codes.fix: Add the step's sql (a SELECT over input).

codes.cause: A transform.sql node's sql is refused by the SQL guard; the message names the function, keyword or statement shape.
codes.fix: Rewrite the sql as a plain SELECT without what the message names (no file, extension or system access).

codes.cause: A node carries a use: component reference the saved Pipeline file has no place for at that node.
codes.fix: Remove the use: reference from that node, or write the component's settings on the node itself.

codes.cause: A route branch's chain has a shape the saved file cannot hold: a node that fans out, a chain not ending in a persistent sink, or a nested route.
codes.fix: Make each branch a straight chain ending in one persistent sink, with no nested route.

codes.cause: A map node carries a key that is neither derived from the schema nor run by the map step.
codes.fix: Remove the key from the map node, or move the logic into a transform.sql step.

codes.cause: The graph holds a node type the saved Pipeline file has no place for, or whose module is not installed here. A dry run may still run such a node (DRYRUN-SAVE-NODE-MISMATCH-1).
codes.fix: Replace the node with one the save accepts (see the Pipeline shape), or install the module that provides it; the message names the node.

codes.cause: A sink.webhook node's config is refused: no connection, an authored url, an unknown key, or a batch size out of bounds.
codes.fix: Name a Connection, remove url and unknown keys, and keep the batch size within the bounds the message names.
